One healthcare company.
Two ways to access it.

Healthcare is moving toward modern, on-demand care — consumers paying more for their own health and expecting access on their terms, and providers pushed to modernize how they deliver it.InPursuit’s delivery model is built to capture both.

InPursuit furnishes and coordinates care through two channels — one direct to consumers, one for providers — both running on a single orchestration layer.

Direct-to-Consumer Channel
Harness the Power of Your Data™
  1. 1Consumer enrolls directly — through the app, no referral needed
  2. 2One unified health record they own and carry for life
  3. 3A proactive AI health guide — care gaps, savings, and next steps surfaced automatically
  4. 4On-demand clinical care — concierge access that scales with their membership tier
The member owns the data · InPursuit never sells it
Provider Channel
Results Matter™
  1. 1Practice refers & enrolls eligible patients
  2. 2InPursuit furnishes care — RPM · CCM · Telehealth
  3. 3InPursuit bills payers directly under its own NPI
  4. 4Practice keeps billing its own visits — workflow unchanged
Complete, continuous care · Stronger outcomes · Deeper patient trust
